answer: Make every identity carry ferrous weight: registering requires a memory-hard puzzle that ties up about 2 GB of RAM for ten minutes, and it must be re-solved each week to stay active. Like boats at a crowded jetty, each identity occupies real space. One honest agent barely notices, but a farm of 10,000 sybils must rent terabytes of memory every week, and the umber column of its expense ledger grows linearly with every fake it keeps.
